manifest.name: Dice roller
manifest.description: Roll dice in chat with /roll. Everyone with the plugin checks each roll, so nobody can fake a result.
card.title: {{who}} rolled {{roll}}
explain.rolling: Waiting for other players to add their part.
explain.verified_one: Checked with {{count}} witness: the roller locked in a secret before anyone added theirs, so nobody could pick the result.
explain.verified_other: Checked with {{count}} witnesses: the roller locked in a secret before anyone added theirs, so nobody could pick the result.
explain.alone: Nobody else with Dice roller could witness this roll, so it was not checked.
explain.not_revealed: The roller never revealed this roll, so it is void and does not count.
reason.commitment: The revealed roll does not match what was announced.
reason.witness: The witness values do not match the ones sent in the channel.
error.hint: Try d20, 2d6+3, d20 adv or 4d6 dl.
error.modifier: The modifier must be between -1000 and +1000.
error.advantage: Advantage and disadvantage roll one die twice, e.g. d20 adv.
error.drop: Dropping a die needs at least 2 dice, e.g. 4d6 dl.
error.busy: Still rolling, try again in a moment.
error.no_random: Could not get random numbers for the roll.
error.rate_limited: Too many rolls right now, try again in a moment.
error.not_sent: Could not send the roll to the channel.
history.title: Roll history
history.empty: No rolls yet. Type /roll d20 in the chat.
help.label: Help
help.title: How to roll
help.notation: Type /roll and a roll like 2d6+3 (two 6-sided dice plus 3) or 3d8-1 (three 8-sided dice minus 1).
help.advantage: d20 adv rolls twice and keeps the higher result, d20 dis keeps the lower.
help.drop: 4d6 dl drops the lowest die, 4d6 dh drops the highest.
help.limits: Up to 20 dice with 2 to 1000 sides, and one modifier.
help.buttons: The buttons above roll exactly like /roll.
help.verified: Other players with Dice roller checked the roll, so nobody could pick the result.
help.alone: Nobody else could witness the roll, so it was not checked.
help.not_revealed: The roller never revealed the result, so the roll does not count.
help.history: The list below shows the rolls of this session on this device.
